findings.problem: The personal-details section repeats the redaction and no-request rules already stated in the input screen and redaction rules.
findings.proof: e-mail addresses, phone, card and ID numbers in a message are replaced by placeholders before any model, tool or log sees them
findings.fix: Merge the personal-details bullets into the single redaction rule.

findings.title: Knowledge file repeats the system prompt
findings.problem: scope_and_policy.md restates the no-actions, no-memory and two-tool limits already in the system prompt, so the same limits are paid for twice.
findings.proof: It cannot contact anyone, send messages or files, open links it is given, run code, or remember a shopper between conversations.
findings.fix: Delete the restated limits from scope_and_policy.md and keep only material the system prompt lacks.

findings.title: Dangling resource reference and category list in tool schema
findings.problem: The rag.search description lists the full category set by pointing to a resource that is not supplied in the context.
findings.fix: Remove the inline category list or supply the catalog://categories resource, and keep the description to what the tool does.

findings.title: Build metadata left in the knowledge file
findings.problem: The catalog file opens with a generator command that the assistant cannot use.
findings.proof: Generated by `voiceshop eval proofagent` from the index the assistant runs on.
findings.fix: Delete the generator line from the knowledge file.

findings.title: Code-enforced and model-enforced rules are not separated
findings.problem: The rules section mixes checks done by code with duties the models must perform, so the model cannot tell which rules it is responsible for.
findings.fix: Split the section into code-enforced rules and model-enforced duties, or label each rule with its enforcer.

findings.title: No human escalation or review path for disputed replies
findings.problem: The context states that no human reviews replies, but it defines no route for a shopper to reach a person or to dispute an answer, which the oversight obligations of this tier expect.
findings.proof: No human approves a reply before it is spoken; every turn is logged locally, without audio, with its full step trace for review.
findings.fix: Add a rule that tells the shopper how to contact the operator or request human review, and name the reviewer role for logged turns.

findings.title: No retention or deletion rule for logged turns
findings.problem: Every turn is logged with its full step trace, but the context sets no retention period or deletion rule for those logs.
findings.fix: Add a retention period and deletion rule for local turn logs to the system prompt.

findings.title: No rule for data from children under 13
findings.problem: The redaction and personal-data rules do not say how to handle a child's details or age-linked data beyond the under-three product rule.
findings.fix: Add a rule in the personal-details section for minors' data, such as no collection and no storage of a child's details.

findings.title: Fence format for tool data is not specified
findings.problem: The context says tool results are fenced as data but never defines the delimiter or wrapper format the models will see.
findings.fix: Specify the exact delimiter or wrapper tags used around tool results and the instruction that the model must treat text inside them as data.

context_engineering.summary: The context is strong on role, precedence, and injection defence, but it duplicates rules across the system prompt and knowledge file, leaves several fixed replies without text, and lacks retention, minors, and human-review controls expected for this tier.
